subject.title: fix(ui): add workboard detail drawer actions

question: Should maintainers use this proof-positive PR as the canonical landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99957 and then close or supersede https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100319?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same remaining Workboard drawer action-parity gap, and selecting the landing branch is a maintainer merge-path decision rather than a code repair ClawSweeper can safely make read-only.

options.title: Land this PR as the action-parity fix
options.body: This branch has the shared helper refactor, focused render/E2E coverage, green current-head checks, and inspected screenshot proof for the changed drawer UI.

options.title: Use the duplicate after proof
options.body: Maintainers could instead wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100319 to gain sufficient real browser proof and then land that branch.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: If maintainers want a different drawer-action design, both action-parity candidates should wait for explicit owner direction.

recommendation.title: Land this PR as the action-parity fix
recommendation.body: This branch has the shared helper refactor, focused render/E2E coverage, green current-head checks, and inspected screenshot proof for the changed drawer UI.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest history-backed connection to the Workboard detail drawer and current affected view/style/test surface.
